system.description:
Wounds that would cripple another are nothing to you; blades bite and arrows sink home, yet your undead flesh simply refuses to acknowledge the harm, carrying you onward where a lesser body would fail.

You gain an extra health level, which behaves as an additional Healthy line on your health level chart. This health level is lost and healed in the same manner as your others. The benefit is passive and permanent, requiring no expenditure and no challenge; Survival serves for any retest of Fortitude.
